svg.aria-label: Light-Prover framework: real workflows feed an untrusted fast build and export; a small trusted judge produces the verdict
svg.text: Complete, sound verification of Lean 4 proofs - fast enough for the edit loop
Most of the speed sits outside a small, pinned judge: a bug in the fast path can cost a verdict, not turn an invalid proof into ACCEPTED.
a verdict on every edit and commit
RH proof, 175,187 modules, from sources on one 384-thread server: about 30 minutes. The untuned official toolchain took 55.7 h on the same server while it was shared;
with one allocator setting the official kernel replay alone takes 13 h 13 min.
